title: Sof's UNIT Programme V2
author: Julián E.
desc: On balance off balance it doesn't matter. Vamos.

ex.note:
Rest 60–90 sec after each Set.
Maximum height every rep.

All power stuff you should finish each set feeling like you could have done several more reps.
Objective:
Maximum jump height/velocity

This is your Oly Lift sub. Try think:
Triple extension
Violent shrug
No arm curl

Again, rest 60–90 sec
Again, rest 60–90 sec after each set

ss.note: For this superset, make your last set a dropset all the way down to no more plates on the machine
For this superset, make your last set a dropset all the way down to no more plates on the machine

ex.note: Maximum distance but you shouldn't be out of breath or tired doing any of them. Rest as much as you want between reps but rest a good 90sec in-between sets
Explosive intent & drive through yer legs.

ss.note: Use pad for back on bench for more rounding (spinal extension and flexion)

ex.note: Quick ground contact & minimal knee bend.
